meta.name: brand-landingpage
meta.description: Brand-first landing page designer — runs a brand-identity interview (colors, typography, shape language), then generates and iterates on a polished landing page via Stitch with deployment-ready HTML. Use when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and has no established visual direction. Skip when they have a design mockup, need a dashboard or app UI, are working at component level, building a multi-page app, or restyling with known design tokens — use frontend-design instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进行品牌访谈,生成可直接部署的落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要一个有品牌调性的落地页但还没定视觉方向
copy.tagline_en: Run a brand interview and generate a deployable landing page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a brand-oriented landing page but don't have a visual direction.

howto.what: 它会先问你几个品牌问题(产品、品牌形容词、颜色字体形状),再用 Stitch 生成落地页 HTML,在浏览器中打开,按你的反馈反复改,最后打包成可部署的压缩包。
howto.when: 当你要求创建、设计落地页或主页等营销页,且还没有既定视觉方向时接管;若你已有设计稿、要做仪表盘或多页应用,则跳过。

say.text: 帮我做个产品落地页,现代风格、深色底。
布局不动,把配色换成暖色调。
say.note: 会针对性地生成新变体。

say.text: 再生成一个手机端版本。
say.note: 桌面版确认后才会问这个。

howto.what_en: It runs a short brand interview (product, brand adjectives, colors, fonts, shapes), then generates a landing page HTML via Stitch, opens it in your browser, iterates on your feedback, and bundles a deploy-ready zip.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to create or design a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and have no visual direction yet. Skip if you have a mockup, need a dashboard, or build a multi-page app.

say_en.text: Build me a landing page for my product, modern and dark.
Keep the layout, switch the colors to warm tones.
